description: This course provides students with an in-depth understanding of the different phases of application/system development, covering topics such as specifying what an application/system should do, requirements gathering techniques, designing application/system architecture, implementing the components of the application/system, and using structured and object-oriented models to represent system functions and data structures. Additionally, the course covers topics related to human-computer interface, database design, and project management.

clos.text: Describe the information systems development life cycle (SDLC).
Apply project management on system design and evaluate system development methodologies.
Discuss the modern approach to system requirements, analysis, and design that combines both process and data views of systems.
Illustrate the use of traditional (structured) and object-oriented (OO) approaches to systems analysis and design
Discuss methodologies of designing systems database, forms, reports, and interfaces.
